source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Boot to BIOS setup menu
    2. Check the value of Build Date and Time in Main page

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Value of Build Date and Time should be shown correctly

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -s bios-release-date 2>&1; echo ---; sudo dmidecode -t 0 2>&1 | grep -i 'Release Date' 2>&1"
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL return the BIOS release/build date+time from `dmidecode -s bios-release-date`. No RISK.

original_test_intent: Visually verify that the BIOS Main-page Build Date and Time matches the approved firmware build metadata, including its representation.
original_method: Enter BIOS Setup, capture the full date-and-time field, compare it to authoritative build metadata with defined format/timezone semantics, use SMBIOS release date only as a date cross-check, and exit safely.
manual_activity: A human must observe the full BIOS Main-page date-and-time field and its formatting; dmidecode exposes only SMBIOS release date on typical platforms.
safety_requirements: Do not fabricate a time component from release-date output.
Preserve logs and verify normal boot.
agent_execution_scope: Collect the exact read-only SMBIOS release-date outputs when later approved.
Compare supplied UI evidence to build metadata and explain format differences.
Report without claiming UI action or verdict.
engineer_actions: Supply authoritative metadata/interpretation and approve window.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Valid for SMBIOS release date only; it does not return build time or prove the BIOS Main page.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the exact command as a date-only cross-check and label its limitation explicitly.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Exact command, Main-page date/time field and 10/10-minute values are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate the UI screenshot with signed/released build metadata and record normalization rules for date order, timezone and seconds precision.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record firmware, BMC, console and dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds an authoritative timestamp source and explicit representation rules.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; SMBIOS remains date-only support.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Release Date may differ semantically from build Date and Time.

project_override_considerations: The expected timestamp is project/build-specific. Supplying it enables execution; a project-approved normalization must be documented and cannot rewrite the master UI check.
expected_evidence: Safe exit/normal boot and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The primary source consistently requires Build Date and Time. The DeepSeek date-only overclaim is a review defect, not a source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Intent is clear; build metadata and UI access are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains the command but rejects its claimed time/UI coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on manual UI core and metadata/format gates.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Applies project-owned expected input without BLOCKED and separates tool result from verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a date-only SMBIOS field from falsely satisfying a date-and-time UI requirement.
independent_technical_reasoning: The command cannot supply the time or prove rendering. Because the acceptance target is a visible composite UI field, human observation remains core and the case is MANUAL ONLY.
no_automatic_retry: Do not re-enter Setup automatically after a mismatch or unresolved timestamp normalization; preserve all evidence and stop.
